description: Answer keys for the 15 coloring-page scenes used in English writing/description practice. Each object entry includes synonyms (for flexible matching), expected count, position in the picture, attributes, and typical action/state. A count of 0 marks an optional detail that is not clearly drawn but can be reasonably added by the student.
usage_notes: Match a student's word against 'name' or any of its 'synonyms' (case-insensitive).
Use 'position' keywords to check prepositions of place (on, next to, in front of, behind, between).
Use 'attributes' to reward richer descriptions (color, shape, size).
Use 'action' to check verb tenses, especially Present Continuous.
Objects with count 0 are optional/inferred details — do not penalize students for omitting them, but you may give bonus credit if mentioned.
